name: The Falling
source:
At the beginning of time, you play an angel who was banished from heaven to hell when he was just a child.
Since his childhood, he is tortured in hell and finally he suffers from personality disorder.

The personalities which are in his mind help him (you) to not go mad because of torture.
He has tortured a lot since he was a kid so he becomes an insensitive person.
During his time in hell, his mood turns into a dark mood.
When he gets stronger enough, he kills the demon that tortures him and begins to look for a way out of hell.
In hell, he meets a woman who shares almost the same faith with him, and they become friends..
His only aim is going home, but it won't be that easy.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thefalling]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在时间之初，你将扮演一名尚在幼年便从天堂被放逐至地狱的天使。
自孩提时代起，他便在地狱中饱受折磨，最终患上了人格分裂症。

脑海中衍生出的多重人格帮助他（也就是你）在酷刑之下免于陷入彻底的疯狂。
长年累月的折磨让他变得麻木冷漠，在地狱度过的漫长岁月里，他的心境也渐渐染上了阴暗的底色。
当他终于积蓄起足够的力量后，他亲手杀死了折磨自己的恶魔，开始寻找逃离地狱的出路。
在地狱之中，他邂逅了一位与自己怀有相似信念的女子，两人结为了挚友……
他唯一的目标便是重返故乡，但这条归途绝不会一帆风顺。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thefalling]Patreon[/url]]
